name: Midnight Roots | 200mg Full Moon Chocolate | Orange Milk Chocolate
description:
Handcrafted Artisan delicious Milk chocolate Smooth, creamy, Refreshing, with just the right amount of sweet, melts in your mouth, and is consistently potent.

Orange Cream has been a staple flavor since 2014, now in our Full Moon size.

Creamy Orange comes together with smooth Milk Chocolate to give you a taste that makes you do a double taste!
